newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas futures seen unchanged to lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas futures seen unchanged to lower.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures are likely to open unchanged to slightly lower on Wednesday after the cash market ended lower again on Tuesday, traders said.
May IPE UK gas was called to open at about 10.15 pence a therm (p/th) unchanged from Tuesday's settlement
"But we could see prices lower again today. There's no shortage of summer gas," said an IPE broker.
May gas lost 0.5 p/th on Tuesday but very prompt cash markets traded as low as nine p/th.

Cash dealers said that pressure on the front end of the forward curve caused by unseasonally warm weather was having a knock-on effect, particularly after TransCo sold gas on the flexibility market at the weekend.
